items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: And I knew Joe when he was a baby.

ctx.x: But it's interesting that so many of the people from that band, the Frank Fairfax band did go on to all those names we just named.
Yeah. And Joe Wiler's dad was a bass player. Curtis Wiler. And I knew Joe when he was a baby.
One of the finest musicians there is. Bar none.
